evidence_quotes:
HYDRO-BOOST –  Converts hydraulic power from the steering pump to mechanical power to the
master cylinder, providing power assist during braking.
statements.reason: The steering-system description states this conversion.
statements.statement: The hydro-boost unit converts hydraulic power from the steering pump to mechanical power to the master cylinder.

evidence_quotes:

statements.reason: The steering-system description explicitly states this function.

evidence_quotes:
A defective power steering pump,
gear, hoses, or control valve could
affect hydro-booster operation.
statements.reason: The brake guidance says a defective power steering pump could affect hydro-booster operation.
statements.statement: The brake guidance identifies the power steering pump as a steering-system component that may influence hydro-boost operation.

evidence_quotes:

statements.reason: The brake guidance lists the gear with the power steering pump as something that could affect hydro-booster operation.
statements.statement: The brake guidance identifies the power steering gear as a steering-system component that may influence hydro-boost operation.

statements.reason: The supplied brake guidance does not identify the fan drive.
statements.statement: The brake guidance identifies the fan drive as a steering-system component that may influence hydro-boost operation.

statements.reason: The guidance names hydro-booster operation as what could be affected, not hydro-boosters as components that could affect it.
statements.statement: The brake guidance identifies hydro-boosters as steering-system components that may influence hydro-boost operation.
